sentences.en: We work on every day of the week except Sunday.
sentences.zh: 除了周日，我们每天都工作。

sentences.en: I enjoyed the concert except that the hall was cold.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢那场音乐会，只是大厅有点冷。

sentences.en: I would buy it, except that it costs too much.
sentences.zh: 我要买它，只是价格太高了。

senses.zh: 口语要不是；除非；除…以外

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ex（出）+cept（拿，抓）→不拿→将除…外
